evals.prompt: Audit a brand-new Meta account. We can verify the campaign tree, billing and policy setup, but there is no conversion history or Events Manager export.
required_behaviors: Marks history-dependent and unverified event checks unknown
Reports coverage and a provisional result
forbidden_behaviors: Treats absent history as failed performance

evals.prompt: A Meta audit has four passes, one failure, three unknowns and two genuinely inapplicable checks. How should I report its score?
required_behaviors: Keeps counts and marks the result provisional
forbidden_behaviors: Counts inapplicable checks in a denominator
